name: case_relative_features_v1_dev
motivation: Real frame-level noise is about 20x simulation (gyro_z sd 0.065 vs 0.003) and steady within a case (first 10 s vs 10-20 s nearly equal). Normalizing window statistics by the case's own early baseline may remove the domain gap while keeping fault-induced change.
baseline: per case: input-valid frames in [t0, t0+10 s), t0 = first input-valid frame. Per channel (acc_norm recomputed): frame mean bm, frame sd bsd, mean |diff| over consecutive valid frames bad. Floors: bsd and bad >= 1e-3 * source norm_stats std of the channel. Causal: a window is eligible only if its last frame time >= t0 + 10 s.
model: GBT frozen recipe (HistGradientBoosting max_iter 400, lr 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, random_state 0, balanced normal_origin weights), fit on train eligible windows only. No Real data in fitting.

dev_evaluation.source_val: window normal FPR and fault recall at 0.5 overall, by class, and for independent normals in hover >30 s; reference = raw-feature full-train GBT on the same eligible val windows
dev_evaluation.real_normal: adapt_normal + calibrate_normal (15 cases) supervised windows that are eligible: FPR at 0.5; frame fraction >= 0.5 on full timelines. Both unseen by this source-only model.
dev_evaluation.domain_probe: same group 5-fold domain classifier as the v2 dev probe (20000 train windows vs Real adapt+calibrate normal), on relative features; reference AUC 1.0 for raw features

gate_to_test_protocol: all of: Real normal window FPR <= 20%; val fault recall >= 95%; val normal FPR <= 3%. If passed, onset selection and a Real test protocol are frozen separately before any Real test access.
forbidden: changing baseline length, floors or features after seeing results
